findings.claim: Admiralty established 1628
findings.correct_value: The Admiralty (Board of Admiralty) is generally dated to 1628 only loosely; the office of Lord High Admiral dates to medieval period, Admiralty commissions date from early-17th century but the modern Admiralty is typically dated 1707/1709. 1628 is not the standard founding date; Admiralty commonly dated c.1546 (Council of Marine Causes) or 1707/1709.
